---
title: "Chlamydia"
format: 
  dashboard:
    scrolling: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

source("R/Master Function.R")

# Disease for this page
disease_name <- "Chlamydia"

# Individual case records
cases <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/fake_cases.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Rename disease column
cases <- cases |>
  rename(
    disease = disease_name
  )

# Spatial boundaries
map_shapes <- sf::st_read(
  "https://services1.arcgis.com/x5wCko8UnSi4h0CB/ArcGIS/rest/services/Brazos_County_City_Limits_and_Zip_Codes_WFL1/FeatureServer/3/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Build every page component
page <- build_disease_page(
  data = cases,
  disease_name = disease_name,
  map_shapes = map_shapes,
  case_geography_variable = "GEOID",
  shape_geography_variable = "Zip_Code",
  geography_label = "ZIP"
)
```
